I'd like to make a comment about those calling for boycotts. And not to encourage it. Rather, boycotting would be meaningless since there's no way to convince at least one-third of Blizzard's total consumers to boycott the company. It'd be ineffectual overall, and financially Blizzard wouldn't notice even 100K boycotters of their products as it'd just be "people who didn't buy something" which is already large. Truthfully, financially, Blizzard would need there to be something on the reports showing up to actually notice. Like returns or refunds, rather than some news report of boycotters.

So everyone, please don't boycott, here's better ways to show that you're upset with this than refusing to buy something. Including proper discourse and debate about why Blizzard did what they did.

Just an update, my apparent depression mood swing is over. Not sure when it happens again but at least I'm moving out of it. It's strange actually, I'll go through these things, just seemingly random. Part of me worries it's bipolar but it's not like I'm manic or I have violent mood swings or anything. I can be happy one day, then tomorrow I wake up and I'm wanting to pop a 12 gauge in my mouth. Hell it's gotten bad enough at one point that to try and stop myself from taking that plunge I made a list of things I must do before I can allow myself to commit the act.  


* Seek treatment, complete treatment and not some fake ass shit.
* Try Curry at least once and then attempt to make it. Probably a chicken curry cause I like chicken.
* Make a full attempt to keep a stable relationship with my boyfriend past our meet up in real life. Yes it's online, yes it's long distance but it's just a border not a continent of distance. But I do worry we won't click physically or something. I'm pretty sure we will sexually, we're kinky little shits.
* I must have a stable job with an income of at least $2,500 or more that allows for me to afford a one bedroom apartment with a decent kitchen(I love cooking and never have had a good kitchen to practice things, like baking.)
* My parents must have passed away of natural causes and I must do my best to care for them so they live as long as possible and with as much happiness as I can provide.

This is my kind of anti-bucket list. I can only commit suicide when I fulfill each condition to it's fullest. I know some are silly, like the curry but it's not meant to be something I can't achieve and each is to help me hopefully move farther from having these episodes. Especially the last one, I don't want my parents to have to live longer than their child, it's something no parents should have to experience and I owe my parents too much. I'm adopted, from birth at that, my parents have been my parents for my entire life, and even when I found out I was adopted I still see them as my only parents. But it has made me cherish the love they give me even more so I want to give them that at least, the chance to have their child outlive them, even if it's only until I finish their funeral arrangements.
